sourceText:
Broccoli - Cheddar Quiche
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 19, 2009 - 11:11pm

Ingredients




10 ounces pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
1 cup grated cheddar cheese
1 1/2 cups milk
3/4 cup Bisquick
3 eggs
1 teaspoon salt (opt.)
Pepper to taste

Preparation

1 Heat oven to 400 degrees. Grease deep dish 9 inch pie plate. Cook broccoli for 5 minutes. Drain. Pour into pie plate, put cheese on top. Beat eggs, milk and Bisquick until smooth and pour over broccoli and cheese. Bake 30 to 40 minutes until set. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.
